question: In what order should the guru meditate on the burning purification process?
premises: The guru sits down to perform the meditation.
The process begins from the root to be purified.
It extends to the end of the final purifiable and proceeds in order.
inference: The guru should sequentially meditate on the burning power from the root purifiable through to the final purifiable.
uncertainties: The technical scope of mūlaśodhya and antaśodhya is not defined within this verse.
plain_english: Having sat down, the guru should then meditate in order on the burning power, beginning from the root to be purified and continuing up to the end of the final purifiable.
